# Heading with `code`

Some **bold** and *italic* prose with a [link](https://example.com) and a ![img](i.png).
An escaped \* asterisk and a bracket in code: `arr[0]`.

```rust
fn a() { b([1]); }
```

Prose between two fences.

```python
d = {'k': [1]}
```

> A quote with a list:
> - item one
> - item two
